title: How DeRot works, in three steps:

copy.threads_text:
How DeRot works, in three steps:

1. Pick the apps that wind you up.
2. Mid-scroll, DeRot pauses you and opens a calming breath exercise.
3. You go back to the feed, or you don't. Your call, just calmer.

No account needed. Coming soon to iPhone.

images.alt: Mid-scroll, DeRot pauses you Not at the door. Right when the feed has wound you up.
Breathe for about a minute Nothing to get right. Just follow the circle.
Then back to your day, calmer Back to the feed, or not. Your call, just calmer.
